record.question: The most common Peritoneal Dialysis catheter used worldwide is :
record.explanation: Answer B: Tenckhoff catheter. Tenckhoff catheter is the standard soft PD catheter and the conventional choice among the listed options; the source does not define “most common worldwide” with a registry or survey. Reference: https://spnp-spp.pt/media/lvaha14e/peritoneal-dialysis-in-acute-kidney-injury-spd-guidelines-paediatrics-2020-1-_compressed.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
